# Transporeon: Freight Procurement API

- **Product:** Transporeon: Freight Procurement API (Transportation family).
- **Disposition:** `reference`. The bridge never calls this API; operations can be searched with `trimble_api_operations` and validated into a dry-run plan with `trimble_api_plan` (omit `product`).
- **Authentication:** per the definition (Transporeon credentials). Declared security schemes: none declared.
- **Access:** Transporeon Freight Procurement (tendering) customers.
- **To call it you would need:** Transporeon credentials for api.transporeon.com/TenderingApi.
- **Documented servers:** `https://api.transporeon.com/TenderingApi`, `https://api.test.transporeon.com/TenderingApi`.
- **Definition:** [transporeon/inline-api-for-freight-procurement](https://transporeon-hcskb.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/ADPD/pages/27230348/API+for+Freight+Procurement) (Freight Procurement Api, version v1.0). Documentation: https://transporeon-hcskb.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/ADPD/pages/27230348/API+for+Freight+Procurement.
